title: Bronoir™ Skin Pro with Copper - Grounding Allround Barefoot Shoes
body_html:
Healthy Foot - Happy You! Your daily companions for sports, leisure, or work.

Conventional shoes like sneakers or boots are often uncomfortable, squeeze the toes, and have a thick, rigid sole that can cause pain in the calves, soles of the feet, or even the spine after prolonged walking.

With the barefoot shoes from Bronoir, you can feel the ground under your feet, your natural gait will be restored and your joints and spine will be protected.

In addition, the shoe helps for foot conditions such as hallux valgus or claw toes.

Comfortable, lightweight, and flexible:

The Bronoir barefoot shoe frees your toes, is super comfortable to wear, and fits like a second skin due to the elastic upper material. This makes your feet more mobile while promoting a natural and upright gait.

Walking on clouds:

Thanks to the ultra-thin soles (4mm), it feels like you're walking barefoot. By directly connecting with the ground, your ligaments and muscles are strengthened & your joints reliefed.

Anti-slip sole and breathability:

The closed rubber sole provides optimal grip and also protects your feet from hot sand, stones and claws. Thanks to breathable synthetic fibers, the sole remains airy, ensuring pleasant breathability. This keeps your feet dry and cool.

Perfect for every everyday situation:

Whether hiking, walking in the woods, sports, or swimming, the Bronoir barefoot shoes are suitable for every everyday situation, making them the perfect all-rounder.

Which size should I choose?

The barefoot shoe is suitable for both women and men and is available in all sizes and colors. See size chart.

Bronoir - SATISFACTION GUARANTEE:

From now on, you are equipped with the best shoes. If the barefoot shoes don't convince you, you can return them to us within 14 days, and the full amount will be refunded.

Convince yourself and make your life easier, just like thousands of customers before you.

title: Bronoir CosyCloud Boot - Warm & Comfy Winter Barefoot Boot
body_html:
Say goodbye to cold feet & discover the Bronoir Fleece

Everyone knows it: cold feet, constricted, frosty toes & clunky heavy shoes that can lead to pain & foot deformities due to poor foot posture. They are often uncomfortable, way too expensive & tire the feet after long wear.

With the Bronoir Fleece, these worries are finally a thing of the past! They not only offer unrivaled grip on slippery surfaces, but thanks to the wide toe box, they also provide an unforgettable feeling of freedom. 

Lined with fluffy warm fleece

Thanks to the fluffy warm fleece lining and the ultra-soft barefoot sole, the Bronoir Fleece perfectly mold to your feet & ensure an ultra-comfortable, warm wearing experience. Cold toes and foot pain caused by the cold are now a thing of the past! 

Non-slip barefoot sole for healthy feet

Thanks to the non-slip barefoot sole, you are safely on the move on any surface, do not slip & feel connected to nature while your feet stay warm.

The natural barefoot feeling also restores the natural gait, effectively relieves pain & foot deformities, and strengthens your foot & calf muscles.

Whether on the mountain, on icy asphalt, or on the way to work, the Bronoir Fleece offer you maximum sure-footedness. 

Ultra flexible & waterproof

Damp and cold feet in winter are extremely troublesome and can lead to frostbite, foot fungus, or "cold pains". That's why it's important to keep your feet dry at all times, especially when you're outside for longer.

The Bronoir Fleece have been developed to be 100% waterproof from bottom to top, keeping your feet dry & warm. They are also flexible, robust & offer you maximum comfort. 

Suitable for every everyday situation

The Bronoir Fleece match any outfit and guarantee you excellent wearing comfort. So, our winter barefoot shoes are your ideal companion in the cold season. Also, the shoe can be adapted to your foot in seconds with the integrated quick-release.
